dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Comfortable, yet elegant. Cozy, yet full of life... You managed to achieve a wonderful balance in this space. You must have put a lot of thought into it.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Perhaps... it's a style all your own.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I love it! It feels... just like home.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I've spent quite a bit of time in other nations, so I'm used to many different aesthetics.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: But, that's not why this place feels so comforting...

choices.text: Oh? Then what is it about this place?

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Perhaps you haven't noticed...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: But, as a well-traveled individual, your wealth of diverse experiences have subconsciously shaped your idea of "home."

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: As you decorated this space, those subconscious ideas likely guided your decisions... Almost like a form of "inspiration," if you will.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Similarly, another area influenced by our subconscious... is the wondrous and mystifying realm of our dreams.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Oho, that was fast. So, what is your interpretation?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Realm Within is a kind of dream?

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Close! But not quite.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Simply put, to a certain extent, this place is a reflection of your hopes and desires... And, things we wish for are very likely to appear in our dreams.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: So, in that sense, this place is like a preview of your dreams — an area that is very familiar to me, of course.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: If I analyze this place, I bet I could even learn a little secret or two...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: It's a bit complicated. We don't need to get into the theory behind it.

choices.text: So, it's not about how this place looks...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Of course! Any time, anywhere, any place! For however long you like...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I'm always happy to lend an ear!

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Although, there is something I wanted to ask, now that I've seen this masterpiece...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: As you get further on your journey... Will you change the look of this place?

choices.text: Change the look of this place?

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Well, let's say you make your way to... Snezhnaya, and the aesthetic catches your eye. Would you try to recreate it here?

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Or, say that you make a new friend. Would you decorate a portion of this Realm to make them feel at home?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I do like to introduce new things from my journey...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: I see. That makes a lot of sense...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Then, I suppose... there could be a few surprises in store one day. I'll look forward to it.

choices.text: Hmm... I don't think there's really a need?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This is a place of freedom and relaxation.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: You've got a point. There's a lesson in there somewhere... Don't get hung up on the little things. It can be much easier to relax that way...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: You have a knack for putting people at ease, and the way you designed this place reflects that... It's wonderful to be here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Well, in my free time, I like to clear my mind and listen to the lyre or the ukulele.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Even solo, the sound is almost dreamlike in its beauty, so pure and sweet...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Some emerging styles even incorporate drums or other stringed instruments to add a stronger beat and a more robust sound.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: In comparison, that kind of music is more like a gripping, vibrant dream, full of energy and passion... Listening to it can feel so intense, it can tire you out or even make you dizzy.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I'm not sure if I'm sensitive to music in general, or if I like music because, like dreams, it's full of different genres, flavors, and emotions...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Whatever the answer, I think it's important to be introspective about these things.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Anyway, I never found the time to pick up an instrument myself... Are you a musician by any chance?

choices.text: Of course! Quite a talented one at that!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I can teach you if you want!

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: I should have known... You remind me of a bard sometimes, you know. There's a certain musical cadence to the way you speak...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: I'm sure taking lessons from you would be quite a therapeutic process...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: I think I'll take you up on that offer... Maestro.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Please be patient with me if I'm a slow learner.

choices.text: I'm not very good. Maybe we could learn together!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I have a few ideas of where to start...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Sounds good! I'll leave it to you, then.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Learning something new with a friend will be an experience to remember! The sooner we learn, the sooner we can start playing our favorite songs...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: If we perform together, I bet we could produce something with a whole new kind of "flavor"... I'm looking forward to it!

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Here's to our musical journey, fellow student!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Mizuki.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Ah, seems like you're full of energy this morning! I feel more awake just talking to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Mizuki.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: #Sweet dreams, {NICKNAME}! Have a good night.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Oh, wow... Looks like you're already an expert on Inazuman open-air hot springs.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: The temperature of the water, the shape of the stone statues, the trees and flowers around the pool, even the placement of the folding screens... Everything is just perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: You might consider becoming a stakeholder in Aisa Bathhouse... If you choose to invest, we could be business partners!

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: A quiet teahouse is the perfect place to unwind... Of course, I'm referring to a quiet ambiance rather than complete silence. Gentle, soothing music played at just the right volume can do wonders for the spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: You know, this is an excellent place for "guided meditation." That's a conventional treatment in my line of work...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: So, here, take a seat. Let go of your troubles, and I will help you relax.
